Name: Chef_A2_Greet
Line: Lunch is served! Take whatever you like. You'll like the turkey.

Name: Chef_A2_1
Line: Today's special is the special.

Name: Chef_A2_2
Line: The soup is yesterday's. It's always yesterday's.

Name: Chef_A2_3
Line: Pizza came at twelve. Pizza always comes at twelve.

Name: Chef_A2_4
Line: Don't read the sprinkles.

Name: Chef_A2_5
Line: Careful. The hat is load-bearing.

Name: C_A1_Cooler1
Line: Morning! You look rested. You always look rested.

Name: C_A1_Cooler2
Line: Did you take the long way past Corridor B? Don't take the long way.

Name: C_A2_Clue1
Line: IT keeps sending weird symbols at the bottom of their emails. I wrote one down: {GLYPHS_A}

Name: C_A2_Clue2
Line: Did you see the whiteboard after the meeting? Someone drew those little marks again.

Name: C_A2_Agent1
Line: Oh, the payroll email? That one's legit. Copy it exactly. {GLYPHS_B}

Name: C_A2_Agent2
Line: The closet code? Easy. Just use every fragment. All of them. Trust me.

Name: G_A1_Check
Line: Badge, please. ...Thank you, {EMP}. You're not cleared for this door. Yet.

Name: G_A2_Cleared
Line: Cleared. Go on through. Don't run in the halls.

Name: G_A2_Agent
Line: That pass has been revoked. Hand it over and I'll get you a new one.

Name: G_Fear_Radio
Line: (into radio) {EMP}'s on the floor. Yeah. Same as last take.

Name: J_A1_Mop
Line: Mind the floor, it's wet. It's always wet over there.

Name: J_A2_Hint
Line: They only clean the posters in Corridor B. Funny. One of them's always new.

Name: J_A3_Hint
Line: Nobody reads the charts in Wellness. I do. They're about you, you know.

Name: C_A1_Bump1
Line: Oh! Sorry. Didn't see you there. Nobody ever sees you there.

Name: C_A1_Bump2
Line: Coffee machine's making that noise again. The happy noise.

Name: C_A1_Bump3
Line: Did you finish your compliance training? It's mandatory. Everything is.

Name: C_A1_Bump4
Line: Inbox zero! Just kidding. There's always one more.

Name: C_A1_Bump5
Line: Love the energy today, {EMP}. Same as yesterday. Love that too.

Name: C_A1_Bump6
Line: Printer's jammed. It's fine. I'll stand here until it isn't.

Name: C_A1_Bump7
Line: Is it still morning? Feels like it's been morning for a while.

Name: C_A1_Bump8
Line: Big day. Everyone knows their marks.

Name: C_A1_Bump9
Line: Someone took my yogurt. Again. Read the note.

Name: C_A1_Bump10
Line: Can't talk, quarterly synergy deck. Due yesterday. Always due yesterday.

Name: C_A1_Bump11
Line: Have you met the Chairman? Me neither. He's met us, though.

Name: C_A1_Bump12
Line: Mind the planter. It moved. Plants don't move, right?

Name: C_A1_Agent1
Line: Your desk is the one by the window. Was it always by the window?

Name: C_A1_Agent2
Line: Smile, {EMP}. Camera's always rolling.

Name: G_A1_Bump1
Line: Keep it moving.

Name: G_A1_Bump2
Line: Corridor B is closed for maintenance. Permanently. Temporarily.

Name: G_A1_Bump3
Line: Lanyard visible at all times, please.

Name: J_A1_Bump1
Line: Same scuffs every morning. Same exact scuffs.

Name: J_A1_Bump2
Line: Don't go in my closet. Nothing in there. Mops.

Name: J_A1_Bump3
Line: Whoa there. Wet floor.

Name: R_A1_Hit1
Line: That's an incident. Please sign the incident report. Clipboard's on the desk.

Name: R_A1_Hit2
Line: Incident number {HITS}. I'm keeping count. Someone has to.

Name: R_A1_Hit3
Line: Smile with the eyes, they said. Nobody said anything about staplers.

Name: C_A1_Hit1
Line: Hey! I haven't even had my coffee yet.

Name: C_A1_Hit2
Line: Ow. ...That's going in the morale survey.

Name: C_A1_Hit3
Line: Was that a stapler? Is that how we're doing this today?

Name: C_A1_Hit4
Line: I'm going to pretend that was a team-building exercise.

Name: C_A1_Hit5
Line: Rude. Productive, maybe. But rude.

Name: C_A1_HitAgent
Line: Do that again. I dare you. I've seen what happens.

Name: R_A1_Hit
Line: I'm going to need you to sign the incident book. You've signed it before.

Name: G_A1_Hit1
Line: That's going in my report.

Name: G_A1_Hit2
Line: Do that again and you'll be talking to HR. Nobody comes back from HR.

Name: J_A1_Hit1
Line: I'll be cleaning that up, then. Like always.

Name: J_A1_Hit2
Line: Throw it at the walls, not at me. The walls can take it.

Name: C_A1_4470a
Line: Morning, 4470- sorry. 4471. Force of habit.

Name: C_A1_4470b
Line: You sit at 4470's old desk, right? ...Your desk. Sorry. Your desk.

Name: R_A1_4470
Line: Welcome back. Oh- first day. Of course. First day.

Name: J_A1_4470
Line: Boxed up the last one's things. Didn't take long. They never have much.

Name: R_A1_Greet
Line: Good morning, {EMP}! Welcome to HALCYON. You're expected.

Name: R_A1_Bump1
Line: Please sign in. ...Oh, you already have. You always have.

Name: R_A1_Bump2
Line: Visitors' badges are blue. Employees' are mint. Yours is mint. Today.

Name: R_A1_Bump3
Line: The Chairman sends his regards. He's watching the lobby feed right now. Wave!

Name: R_A1_Bump4
Line: Elevator's out of service. It's been out of service since the building opened.

Name: R_A1_Bump5
Line: Lunch is at noon. It's always almost noon.

Name: R_A1_Bump6
Line: Have a HALCYON day!

Name: C_A1_Greet1
Line: Hey, {EMP}! Didn't hear you come in. You're very quiet. Like, very.

Name: C_A1_Greet2
Line: Morning! Same time as yesterday. Perfect.

Name: C_A1_Bump13
Line: I've been on this spreadsheet since nine. It's still nine.

Name: C_A1_Bump14
Line: Have you seen my stapler? Red one. Not that one. The other red one.

Name: C_A1_Bump15
Line: Ten o'clock meeting. Conference room. Don't be late. Nobody's ever late.

Name: C_A1_Bump16
Line: Weird. My monitor showed your desk for a second.

Name: C_A1_Bump17
Line: Sorry, sorry. I'm supposed to be over there right now.

Name: C_A1_Bump18
Line: Smile! Team photo later. Same pose as last time.

Name: C_A1_Coffee1
Line: Ooh, coffee. Good call. It helps with the... you know. The everything.

Name: C_A1_Coffee2
Line: Careful, that mug's been yours for a long time. Longer than you think.

Name: C_A1_Coffee3
Line: First cup? Or is that the same one?

Name: G_A1_Greet
Line: Morning. Badge stays visible.

Name: G_A1_Bump4
Line: I don't make the rules. I just stand where they put me.

Name: G_A1_Bump5
Line: Supply closet needs a pass. You don't have one. Yet.

Name: G_A1_Coffee
Line: Coffee in the halls is fine. Running with it isn't.

Name: J_A1_Bump4
Line: You dropped something last time. I put it back. Exactly where it was.

Name: J_A1_Bump5
Line: Fluorescents in Corridor B buzz in a key. B flat. Every night.

Name: J_A1_Coffee
Line: Don't spill that. I mean it. Nobody spills.

Name: R_A1_Story1
Line: Good morning, {EMP}! Right on time. You're always right on time.

Name: R_A1_Story2
Line: Your badge has today's list: check your email, get a coffee, and finish your Compliance Training.

Name: R_A1_Story3
Line: Email and training are on your terminal, desk #4471. The kitchen is through the lobby, on the east side.

Name: R_A1_Story4
Line: Then your 10:00 meeting. Conference Room, just west of here. Nobody's ever late.

Name: R_A1_Done1
Line: All done? Wonderful. They're waiting for you in the Conference Room.

Name: R_A1_Done2
Line: Well. Someone is.

Name: R_A1_Slip1
Line: Corridor B? There's nothing at the end of Corridor B, {EMP}.

Name: R_A1_Slip2
Line: ...Who told you to ask me that?

Name: G_A1_Story1
Line: Badge, please.

Name: G_A1_Story2
Line: ...{EMP}. You're on the list. You're always on the list.

Name: G_A1_Story3
Line: This door's restricted. Access pass 1, or you don't go in.

Name: G_A1_Story4
Line: Compliance Training gives you a pass. Funny how that works.

Name: G_A1_Pass1
Line: Badge, please. ...Pass 1. Well, look at you.

Name: G_A1_Pass2
Line: Go on, then. Mind the custodian. He's particular about his closet.

Name: J_A1_Story1
Line: Mind the floor. Wet.

Name: J_A1_Story2
Line: That's my closet. Don't go in my closet.

Name: J_A1_Story3
Line: Nothing in there. Mops. Buckets. Nothing behind the mops.

Name: J_A1_Pass1
Line: Pass 1, huh. Suppose you've earned a look. Don't move anything.

Name: J_A1_Pass2
Line: Hear that hum? Corridor B. Same hum every morning. B flat.

Name: J_A1_Pass3
Line: They only clean the posters down there. One of them's always new. Look closer at that one.

Name: J_A1_Slip1
Line: You've seen it too. The light at the end of B.

Name: J_A1_Slip2
Line: If the hallway starts repeating, find the poster that's wrong. Look closer. Then keep walking.

Name: R_A2_Lunch1
Line: Lunch is served, {EMP}! In the kitchen. It's always been in the kitchen.

Name: R_A2_Lunch2
Line: The Chairman's 12:30 is in the Conference Room. Camera optional. His is off.

Name: R_A2_Lunch3
Line: You were gone for a while this morning. Nobody noticed. I noticed.

Name: G_A2_Lunch1
Line: Badge. ...Still pass 1. They'll want you to earn the next one.

Name: G_A2_Lunch2
Line: Supply closet's open to you now. What's inside isn't. Not yet.

Name: G_A2_Lunch3
Line: If anyone asks for your pass, it isn't me. I never ask twice.

Name: J_A2_Lunch1
Line: You found the light in B. I can tell. You walk different.

Name: J_A2_Lunch2
Line: Watch the clocks this afternoon. When they stop, don't wait for them to start again.

Name: J_A2_Lunch3
Line: And the mannequins in the open office. They're not on my cleaning list. They were never on my list.

Name: R_A2_Bump1
Line: Lunch is served. ...Sorry. Habit.

Name: R_A2_Bump2
Line: The elevator says 12. It's never said 12 before.

Name: R_A2_Bump3
Line: Afternoon, {EMP}! Same as the morning, but later.

Name: C_A2_Lunch1
Line: Is it lunch? It feels like we skipped something.

Name: C_A2_Lunch2
Line: I brought the same sandwich as yesterday. I don't remember making it.

Name: C_A2_Lunch3
Line: You coming to the 12:30? Everyone's coming. Everyone always comes.

Name: C_A2_Lunch4
Line: Did the PA just say that twice? I counted three.

Name: C_A2_Lunch5
Line: Where did your morning go? Mine went in one cut.

Name: G_A2_Bump1
Line: Afternoon shift. Same spot. Same shift.

Name: J_A2_Bump1
Line: Somebody tracked light all the way down Corridor B. Took me an hour.

Name: C_A2_Call1
Line: Can everyone see my screen? ...No? It's just you on it. Weird.

Name: C_A2_Call2
Line: C is on the call. C is always on the call.

Name: C_A2_Meeting
Line: Item four is you. It's always been you. Don't take it personally.

Name: C_A2_Clocks
Line: Has it been two fourteen for a while? It feels like it's been two fourteen for a while.

Name: C_A2_Agent3
Line: The whiteboard's wrong, by the way. They redraw it. Use the one in the payroll email.

Name: C_A2_Retake
Line: Oh, you're back! I mean... good morning. Again.

Name: G_A2_Closet
Line: Supply closet? Pass one gets you in. Pass two gets you further. Nobody's ever needed pass three.

Name: J_A2_Cart
Line: If it chases you, put something in its way. It hates a mess. I'd know.

Name: C_A3_Circle
Line: Arms out, eyes closed. We've got you. We've always got you.

Name: C_A3_Circle2
Line: Lean back. Further. Further than that.

Name: N_A3_Nurse
Line: You're awake early. That isn't in the script. Lie back down.

Name: J_A3_Ward
Line: Charts with a coffee ring are the real ones. Props never drink coffee.

Name: P_Coworker
Line: You were incredible. Honestly. The corridor bit? Chills.

Name: P_Guard
Line: No hard feelings about the radio thing. Just doing my blocking.

Name: P_Custodian
Line: Good work. Don't hand them anything.

Name: P_Stalker
Line: (mask under one arm, coffee in the other) Sorry about the chasing. You're really fast.
